text:
For photon–photon annihilation \(\gamma\gamma\to e^+e^-\), the invariant energy must satisfy \(s\ge 4m_e^2c^4\). For a head-on collision,

\[
s=4E_\gamma \epsilon_{\rm CMB},
\]

so the threshold is

\[
E_{\gamma,\mathrm{th}}=\frac{m_e^2c^4}{\epsilon_{\rm CMB}}.
\]

Using \(m_ec^2=0.511\,\mathrm{MeV}=5.11\times10^5\,\mathrm{eV}\) and \(\epsilon_{\rm CMB}=10^{-3}\,\mathrm{eV}\),

\[
E_{\gamma,\mathrm{th}}
=\frac{(5.11\times10^5)^2}{10^{-3}}\,\mathrm{eV}
\approx 2.6\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{eV}
=2.6\times10^5\,\mathrm{GeV}.
\]

Answer: B
